//: All paths are relative to this file's directory and use '/' separators, which Python resolves correctly on Windows, Linux and macOS. Absolute paths are also accepted. See README section 12 for every option.
//timezone: 'local' follows the machine. A fixed offset such as '+05:30' works everywhere; an IANA name such as 'Asia/Kolkata' needs a timezone database (built in on Linux/macOS, 'pip install tzdata' on Windows).
//server: host must be a loopback address; the dashboard serves prompt text and has no authentication, so anything else is refused at startup.
//ignore_paths: Glob patterns, written with '/' separators on every platform, e.g. ['*/client-confidential', 'D:/Scratch/*', '/home/me/scratch/*'].
